description: This file defines a CMake function 'compile_aidl' used for generating source code from AIDL files during the build process. It includes detailed documentation and usage examples for integrating AIDL compilation into a CMake-based build system.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code in specified languages, with configurable options for the compiler path, flags, include directories, and output directory.
